name: seed-equivalence-guard
body: The eligibility check that admits the splice when the local seed provably matches the shared recorded scan. The seed's own recorded content-identity key equals the shared record's key, and a missing key on either side makes the seed ineligible; a refusal hands the caller to the full load, the correctness reference. The guard additionally requires that the assembled graph's durable-layer and transient rows are already represented in the seed, so a spec-only change-set that omits them is refused rather than publishing a diverged DB.
